meta.title: SpecFence high-bound OCC-gap collection (全部跑一遍)

method.dag: Final-RW conflict DAG via analyze_dag (RAW+WAW; beneficiary/basic_lazy excluded). Same as lab/notes/specfence-10block-parallel-upper-bound.md.
method.t_work: sequential wall, or OCC@1 if serial > 5× OCC@1
method.occ: OCC@8 Soft=0 finegrain wall; for self-destruct FallbackToSequential blocks, DAG from aborted parallel capture and OCC wall overlaid from all-blocks-sf-occ-sweep when lower

meta.exclusion_note: near_independent_meta_gap removed from main selected set: no analysis value for SpecFence; meta/scheduler/cold-start overhead is unavoidable and SpecFence cannot optimize it. Kept in appendix_excluded_meta_gap for reference.

rationale.min_bound_at_8: Corpus p25 bound@8≈5.96; ≥5 keeps only high structural ceilings (excludes pure spines ~1–2.5×).
rationale.min_occ_over_ideal: Among bound≥5, median OCC/ideal≈5.75; ≥4 is a clear shortfall floor that still includes named 10-block high-bound members (19469097≈4.8, 19606599≈4.3).
rationale.min_n_tx: Drop microblocks (n<30) where OCC fixed overhead inflates OCC/ideal without meaningful abs waste.
rationale.min_abs_waste_ms: Require ≥0.5 ms absolute (OCC−ideal) so tiny quiet blocks with huge ratios but <0.5 ms waste are not in the all-run set.
